_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic page, spare knowing ink line with soft watercolor in muted ochre, slate blue and misty sea-foam green, Pacific Northwest coastal light, economy of line, quiet composition. model sheet of a small plump songbird with a teal head, rose-pink breast, green wing and long teal tail, perched on a weathered seawall, on a dock piling, on a window sill beside three jars, and in flight; soft watercolor; labeled THE BIRD. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, saturated color, neon, anime, busy composition, watermark, extra fingers
